ladder.question: By December 31, 2027, what will be the state of HBM supply and pricing: will SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung have brought meaningful new commercial HBM capacity online, and will record-high HBM/memory contract prices still be in effect? Resolve this using memory-market research and the producers’ capacity and ramp disclosures covering 2027; treat October 1 through December 31 as late 2027 and exclude pilot or qualification output from commercial capacity.

not_judged.part: How much new HBM capacity the three producers will bring online.
not_judged.why: The tracked outcome asks whether meaningful new capacity comes online, not its amount.

not_judged.part: Whether this supply and pricing situation constrains NVIDIA's GPU shipments through input costs.
not_judged.why: This is a potential effect on NVIDIA, not the state of HBM supply and pricing named as the tracked outcome.

states.label: No new capacity; record prices persist
states.condition: No meaningful new commercial HBM capacity from SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung is online by December 31, 2027, and the latest applicable 2027 market research reports record-high HBM/memory contract prices still in effect.

states.label: No new capacity; record prices do not persist
states.condition: No meaningful new commercial HBM capacity from SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung is online by December 31, 2027, and the latest applicable 2027 market research does not report record-high HBM/memory contract prices still in effect.

states.label: Earlier capacity; record prices persist
states.condition: Meaningful new commercial HBM capacity from at least one of SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung is online by September 30, 2027, and the latest applicable 2027 market research reports record-high HBM/memory contract prices still in effect.

states.label: Earlier capacity; record prices do not persist
states.condition: Meaningful new commercial HBM capacity from at least one of SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung is online by September 30, 2027, and the latest applicable 2027 market research does not report record-high HBM/memory contract prices still in effect.

states.label: Capacity first arrives in late 2027
states.condition: Meaningful new commercial HBM capacity from at least one of SK Hynix, Micron, or Samsung first comes online from October 1 through December 31, 2027, regardless of whether record-high HBM/memory contract prices are still in effect.

reference.words: “None of that supply, though, arrives before late 2027, which keeps the memory shortage going and record-high prices intact for now,” Partsinevelos said.
